sources.snippet: A unified quantization platform GPT-QModel provides a consistent API for calibration, quantization, quality evaluation, model conversion, and accelerated inference. It supports GPTQ, AWQ, ParoQuant, QQQ, GGUF, FP8, EXL3, GPTAQ, EoRA, GAR, and FOEM across supported hardware and runtime integrations.
